real_estate_intro_1: Nyumba zakhala chikayikidwe chodalirika kwa zaka zambiri ndipo nthawi zambiri zimaonedwa ngati malo okhazikika osungira chuma.
real_estate_intro_2: Bitcoin ndi ndalama zadigitala zomwe zinapangidwa mu 2009 ndipo anthu ambiriso amayiona ngati malo osungira chuma ndi chikayikidwe.
real_estate_intro_3: Koma kodi katundu wooneka umasiyana bwanji ndi ndalama zadigitala ngati Bitcoin? Tiyeni tione kusiyana pakati pa Bitcoin ndi Nyumba.
point_1_summary_1: Bitcoin imayenda kulikonse padziko lapansi pomwepo. Malo amamangidwa kumalo amodzi ndipo ali pachiwopsezo cha zachuma, ndale, ndi zachilengedwe za m'deralo.
point_2_summary_1: Bitcoin imagawanika m'magawo 100 miliyoni a satoshi. Malo singagulitsidwe pang'ono — simungagulitse khitchini kapena kugula theka la chipinda.
point_3_summary_1: Bitcoin imagwira ntchito pa netiweki yopanda wolamulira yomwe palibe boma lingathe kulamulira. Malo amalamulidwa kwambiri — zoning, kuwongolera renti, eminent domain, ndi kulanda zonse zikugwira ntchito.
point_4_summary_1: Bitcoin saifuna kusamalidwa. Malo amafunika kukonza, kusintha, inshuwalansi, kasamalidwe ka katundu, ndi mavuto a omwe akukhalamo.
point_5_summary_1: Bitcoin ilibe misonkho yopitilizika — mukulipira capital gain pakangogulitsa. Malo amalipira misonkho ya katundu chaka chilichonse mosaganizira ndalama.
point_6_summary_1: Bitcoin yokweza moyenera ikhoza kupulumuka pa moto, madzi osefukira, ndi chivomerezi. Malo ali pachiwopsezo cha tsoka lililonse, ndipo inshuwalansi sikufikira pa zonse.
point_7_summary_1: Bitcoin iliyonse imafanana ndipo ingasinthidwe. Malo aliwonse ndi apadera, kupangitsa kupanga mitengo ndi kuyerekeza kovuta.
point_8_summary_1: Bitcoin imagulitsidwa padziko lonse 24/7 ndi aliyense amene ali ndi internet. Kugulitsa malo kuli kochepa kwa ogula a m'derali ndipo kungatenge miyezi yambiri yokhala ndi mapepala.
point_9_summary_1: Bitcoin imathandiza kukhala ndi okha kwa aliyense. Kugula malo ngati ndalama kupitirira nyumba yanu yayikulu kumakulitsa mitengo ya nyumba, kuchepetsa kukwanitsa kwa anthu ena ndikupangitsa zovuta zanyumba.
